answer_2.quote: We utilize two other metrics: inform F1 and match rate to estimate the task success. ... Evaluation of a task‑oriented dialog system mainly consists of the cost and task success. We count the number of dialog turns to reflect the dialog cost.

answer_4.quote: We hire Amazon Mechanical Turkers to conduct pairwise comparison between MADPL and baselines. Each Turker is asked to read a user goal first, then we show 2 dialog sessions around this user goal, one from MADPL and the other from another baseline, and judge which dialog is better (win, draw or lose) according to: (I) system quality, (II) user quality, and (III) task success.
answer_4.guideline: Turkers compare two dialogs and decide which is better based on system quality, user quality, and task success.
